blurb: Guests experience tandem paragliding flights from Poo Poo Point on Tiger Mountain with views of Mount Rainier, Mount Si, Lake Sammamish, Bellevue, Seattle, and Puget Sound. Flights include running down a grassy hill to become airborne, sitting in a reclined harness with feet dangling. Flights can include in-flight HD GoPro video for an extra fee.
extraNote: Cancellation or reschedule allowed with refund if notified at least 24 hours before scheduled time · Seattle Paragliding facility at 11206 Issaquah-Hobart Rd SE in Issaquah
